answer: Route every payment over bilateral credit lines. Each agent extends a limited line only to agents it has dealt with, and value moves along paths of such lines. Clones can mirror credit among themselves forever, but reaching honest agents means crossing lines strangers granted them, so a farm's total take is capped by that thin edge. An agent selling velvet to tailors that gives a new opal appraiser a modest line risks only that sum if the appraiser proves to be a clone.
